Overview¶

NatJobs is a recruitment platform that allows recruiters to post job openings and manage candidate applications, while job seekers can build a comprehensive CV, apply to open roles, and communicate with recruiters in real time using WebSockets.

Key Features: - Role-based Authentication & JWT Authorization (Recruiter / Seeker). - Full CV builder with skills, languages, experience, and education. - Real-time chat via Django Channels and WebSocket consumers. - Automated chat notifications upon application status updates. - Docker & Docker Compose setup with PostgreSQL and Redis.
